base_member_text: [L504-L523] (LOW/bounds contract) makecrossvector uses caller-supplied mg directly as a row or column index without validating it against the selected array.
audit_member_text: [L499-L523] (MED/bounds-rank-contract) makecrossvector indexes every requested variable through r2/i2 at mg and assigns it into a caller section without validating variable rank, mg bounds, or destination extent.

base_member_text: [L337-L351,L441-L477] (HIGH/state not reset) The saved sine and cosine accumulators used for thetamean are never cleared by clearaverage, so each nominal averaging period includes all prior periods.
audit_member_text: [L337-L351,L441-L477] (HIGH/state-reset) The saved circular accumulators tvar2d_sin and tvar2d_cos are never reset by clearaverage, so later averaging periods include all prior periods even though the published mean arrays are cleared.

base_member_text: [L389-L412,L423-L424] (HIGH/unsupported integer mean) Although initialization accepts integer rank-3 and rank-4 mean variables, makeaverage unconditionally uses real components and real rotation paths for those ranks.
audit_member_text: [L389-L412] (HIGH/type-contract) Rank-3 averaging always sizes temporaries from t%r3 and calls the real grid-rotation path even though means_init explicitly permits rank-3 integer variables, making integer selections dereference the wrong component.

base_member_text: [L196-L201,L218-L225,L242-L251] (HIGH/wrong array component) Local mean initialization sizes integer rank-2/3/4 variables through the real pointer components r2/r3/r4 instead of i2/i3/i4, which can dereference unassociated pointers.
audit_member_text: [L199-L201,L222-L225,L247-L251] (HIGH/wrong-component) All local integer-array initialization branches obtain dimensions from the real pointer components r2/r3/r4 instead of i2/i3/i4, which may be unassociated and is not the selected variable storage.

base_member_text: [L83-L90,L187] (MED/unchecked mnemonic lookup) Mean-variable names are converted to indices and used immediately without checking for an unknown mnemonic.
audit_member_text: [L82-L94] (MED/input-validation) means_init passes chartoindex results directly to index allocation and lookup without rejecting an unknown mean-variable index.

base_member_text: [L413-L415] (HIGH/wrong array component) Rank-4 averaging sizes its first three dimensions from t%r3 rather than t%r4, so a normal rank-4 variable can fail before accumulation begins.
audit_member_text: [L413-L435] (HIGH/wrong-rank-component) Rank-4 temporary dimensions 1 through 3 are taken from t%r3 rather than t%r4, so a normal rank-4 variable can dereference an unassociated rank-3 pointer or allocate the wrong shape.

base_member_text: [L330-L351] (HIGH/angle-unit mismatch) When rotation is enabled gridrotate converts thetamean to degrees, but makeaverage immediately passes those values to SIN and COS as though they were radians.

[L351-L354] (HIGH/representation contract mismatch) The live code stores the circular mean directly as atan2(sine,cosine) while the former packed sine/cosine representation is commented out, leaving downstream consumers that decode the packed representation incompatible.

[L337-L387] (MED/circular-statistics inconsistency) thetamean receives a circular mean but its variance, minimum, and maximum are still computed with linear angle arithmetic, which is discontinuous across the direction wrap.

[L324-L329,L378-L385,L394-L409,L417-L432] (MED/numerical stability) The variance recurrence divides a cross term by an epsilon-substituted old mean, so cancellation near a zero mean can strongly amplify roundoff despite the nominal zero guard.

audit_member_text: [L94-L185,L194-L267] (MED/rank-contract) Initialization handles only ranks 2 through 4 and has no default rejection, leaving unsupported requested ranks with unallocated accumulator pointers.
[L313] (MED/arithmetic) The averaging weight evaluates par%dt/par%tintm before max can clamp it, so a zero averaging interval still causes division by zero.

[L337-L351] (MED/numerical-guard) The near-zero circular-mean guard computes numeps*sign(tvar2d_cos,1.d0), which remains zero when cosine is zero and is far below numeps otherwise, so it does not reliably prevent the invalid atan2(0,0) case.
